HOW HOURLY BILLING WORKS

Working time and task-specific standby.

Working hours cover time actively spent on your task. Standby hours cover time you agree to reserve a specialist’s availability for that task, even when no active work is needed.

We agree the task, hourly rates, standby window and expected hours with you before work begins. Your quote sets out working and standby charges separately.

Standalone ICT services are quoted separately from the per-employee EOR packages below.
